categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label and modifies migration logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration failures and an unhandled std::bad_function_call exception when migrating keyless watch-only wallets. Migration correctness is explicitly prioritized in the wallet category, and this resolves issue #36483 where in-memory transaction validation caused migration to fail and database abort callbacks threw exceptions.
